name: IntegrateIT Remote Detection
notes: Reports which handheld remote class is driving a room, from six explicitly bounded classes (SR-250, SR-260, Halo, Halo Touch, Neeo, Other Remote) detected via button-link bindings or Composer programming. Duplicate-press suppression, a stale-activity timeout, offline and reconnect tracking, low-battery reporting, a privacy mode, and MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing are built in.
